title: 第6章 继承掌门之位
slug: 九阳剑圣全本免费-九阳剑圣最新章节列表
content_zh:
到了第五招，现实又将阳顶天之前的得意全部打消得干干净净，因为进度慢到发指。
第五招是最重要的一招，需要在打拳出去将玄气发出的同时，体内的筋脉同时凝聚足够的玄气在气海内，支撑下一次的攻击，至少需要坚持三轮。
足足三个月后，阳顶天连第一轮都没有完成，他需要在玄气发出去之后，半分钟内才能凝聚新的玄气。
这个进度，让他自己都有些绝望了。但是阳顶天绝对是那种越绝望越奋起的人，所以到最后完全是疯狂的联系。每天三个小时的时间结束之后，就在脑子里面拼命地想，晚上做梦也在想。
三个月，四个月……
这个世界的夏天过去了，秋天也过去了，再次进入了对冬天。（北处极寒之地其实一年到头都是冬天，只不过为了区别，稍稍不冷的就是夏天，很冷的就是冬天）
寒冷的冬天，一场大雪接着一场大雪。让阳顶天暂时把精力从正阳拳上面移开，每天的联系后开始制作寒冰台阶。
因为除了练武之外，还有一件更加重要的事情，那就是早日带着老头离开这个贵地方。
终于这个冬天的第十次大雪后，阳顶天的寒冰台阶完成了99.99%，距离地面仅仅只有十几个台阶，只有三四米距离了。
只要再来一次大雪，阳顶天足足一年的寒冰台阶就要完成了，足足上万个寒冰台阶的巨大工程就要完成了，他就可以带着老头离开这个鬼地方了。
他被困在这个寒冰洞穴里面已经超过一年了。现在，很快就可以离开了。
******
阳顶天睡得迷迷糊糊间，忽然觉得脸上一寒，顿时赶紧睁开双眼。
下雪了，果然又下雪了。而且下得很大，这次的积雪完全足够做完剩下的十几级寒冰台阶了。
阳顶天先没有去做寒冰台阶，而是先开始进行一个小时的天地诀坐息吐纳，再进行三个小时的正阳拳第五招。
现在，他发完一次玄气攻击后，全身筋脉需要积攒15秒钟左右才能凝聚起下一次的玄气攻击。所以不要说完成三轮，他连第一轮都没有完成。此时，阳顶天已经放下所有轻浮的幻想，准备打持久战了。
但是……上天好像给他开了一次玩笑。
今天早上，他如同往常一样进行正阳拳第五招的练习。
“砰……”一拳打出去，将前面的雪花震开。
“砰……”

“砰……”
“砰……”
没有任何预兆，阳顶天接连打出去了十波玄气攻击，甚至他自己都没有意识到，完全是接连不断发出了，不需要任何的积累时间，全身的筋脉就已经瞬间凝聚了新的玄气。
发现之后，阳顶天彻底惊呆了。怎么，怎么会这样？之前花了四个月连三分之一的进度都完成不了，他都准备花一两年去完成了，没想到忽然之间直接就通过了，完成了第五招。而且要求只是进行三轮，结果他足足进行了十几轮。
阳顶天害怕只是幻觉，或者只是偶尔的，所以再次尝试正阳拳第五招。
没错，他可以轻易地打出去十几波玄气攻击，在十三波之后，他身体的筋脉才需要一个积攒凝聚新玄气的过程。
阳顶天完全被镇住了，甚至忘记了欢呼。
而这个时候，老头忽然睁开眼睛道：“没错，武道就是这样奇妙，他大部分会让你沮丧难过，但是偶尔忽然会给你无限的惊喜。当然，这所有的惊喜都建立在悟性和天赋之上。”
接下来，老头又重复了一句：“唉，人比人，气死人！”
阳顶天望着自己的拳头，然后在雪花中挥舞拳头道：“爷爷，我练完了正阳拳。还有我的寒冰台阶马上就要做完了，我们可以出去了，我们可以出去了……”
“爷爷，我们可以出去了……”阳顶天忍不住兴奋喊道。
他平时是不能这么喊的，他曾经喊过几次，结果被老头呵斥了。但是这次兴奋之下，他忍不住又喊出了爷爷两个字，然后赶紧闭嘴，等待着老头再一次严厉的呵斥。
老头缓缓睁开双目，仰头望着飘飘洒洒的大雪，再看了一眼兴奋的阳顶天，没有像往常一样发怒，先是微微一笑，然后叹息一声，道：“这一天终于要到来了。”
“是啊，我们终于可以出去了。”阳顶天兴奋道。

content_en:
By the fifth move, reality wiped away all Yang Dingtian's previous pride, because the progress was so slow.
The fifth move is the most important move. While punching out to release the profound energy, the muscles and veins in the body must simultaneously condense enough profound energy into the sea of ​​energy to support the next attack. It needs to last for at least three rounds.
Three full months later, Yang Dingtian had not even completed the first round. He needed to gather new profound energy within half a minute after the profound energy was sent out.
This progress made him a little desperate. But Yang Dingtian is definitely the kind of person who gets more desperate the more desperate he gets, so in the end it was a completely crazy connection. After the three hours every day, I think about it desperately in my mind, and I also think about it in my dreams at night.
Three months, four months...
The summer of this world has passed, autumn has passed, and winter has entered again. (In the extremely cold places in the north, it is actually winter all year round, but for the sake of distinction, it is summer when it is not too cold, and winter when it is very cold)
In the cold winter, heavy snow comes one after another. Let Yang Dingtian temporarily divert his energy from Zhengyang Fist, and start making ice steps after daily contact.
Because besides practicing martial arts, there is another more important thing, which is to take the old man out of this expensive place as soon as possible.
Finally, after the tenth heavy snowfall this winter, 99.99% of Yang Dingtian's ice steps were completed, with only a dozen steps or three or four meters left from the ground.
As long as there is another heavy snowfall, Yang Dingtian will be able to complete the ice steps that last for a year, and the huge project of tens of thousands of ice steps will be completed, and he can take the old man and leave this ghost place.
He has been trapped in this ice cave for more than a year. Now, you can leave soon.
****
Yang Dingtian was drowsily asleep when he suddenly felt a chill on his face and quickly opened his eyes.
It's snowing, and sure enough it's snowing again. And it was raining heavily, and the snow this time was completely enough to complete the remaining dozen or so steps of ice.
Yang Dingtian did not do the Ice Steps first, but first started to practice the Heaven and Earth Technique of Sitting and Breathing for an hour, and then performed the fifth move of Zhengyang Fist for three hours.
Now, after he sends out a profound energy attack, the muscles and veins in his body need to accumulate for about 15 seconds before he can gather the next profound energy attack. So let alone completing three rounds, he didn't even complete the first round. At this time, Yang Dingtian had put aside all frivolous fantasies and was ready to fight a protracted war.
But... God seemed to have played a joke on him.
This morning, he practiced the fifth move of Zhengyang Fist as usual.
"Bang..." He punched out, shaking away the snowflakes in front of him.
"Bang..."
"Bang..."
"Bang..."
Without any warning, Yang Dingtian fired ten waves of profound energy attacks one after another. He didn't even realize that they were sent out in succession. Without any accumulation time, the muscles and veins in his body had instantly condensed new profound energy.
After discovering this, Yang Dingtian was completely shocked. Why, how could this happen? It took him four months to complete even one-third of the progress. He was ready to spend a year or two to complete it. Unexpectedly, he suddenly passed it and completed the fifth move. And the requirement was only for three rounds, but he ended up doing more than a dozen rounds.
Yang Dingtian was afraid that it was just an illusion, or just an accident, so he tried the fifth move of Zhengyang Fist again.
Yes, he could easily unleash more than a dozen waves of profound energy attacks. After thirteen waves, his body's tendons would need a process of accumulating and condensing new profound energy.
Yang Dingtian was completely stunned and even forgot to cheer.
At this time, the old man suddenly opened his eyes and said: "Yes, martial arts is so wonderful. Most of the time it will make you depressed and sad, but occasionally it will give you unlimited surprises. Of course, all of thisSurprises are all based on understanding and talent. "
Next, the old man repeated: "Oh, comparing people to each other is so annoying! "
Yang Dingtian looked at his fist, then waved it in the snowflakes and said: "Grandpa, I have finished practicing Zhengyang Fist. And my ice steps will be finished soon, we can go out, we can go out..."
"Grandpa, we can go out now..." Yang Dingtian couldn't help shouting excitedly.
He usually couldn't shout like this. He had shouted a few times, but the old man scolded him. But this time in his excitement, he couldn't help but shout out the word "grandpa" again, and then quickly shut up, waiting for the old man to scold him severely again.
The old man slowly opened his eyes, looked up at the falling snow, and then glanced at the excited Yang Dingtian. He did not get angry as usual. He first smiled slightly, then sighed and said: "This day is finally coming. "
“Yeah, we can finally go out. Yang Dingtian said excitedly.
